title: Provide per-session body sequence on body commits, reads and proxied events
outcome: Provide per-session body sequence on body commits, reads and proxied events
acceptance: Server implements S1–S5 of governing contract 9a7e6f43436b4385967202c448d296f7, with sessionSeq on body deltas and bodySeq on targeted reads/history/summary; per-session sequence is taken atomically with body mutation and snapshot capture.

Server tests pin contiguous body commits, metadata non-advancement, read-to-next-delta relation, SQLite page snapshot truth including a rollback during a history read, a rollback advancing the session's body sequence so that a client sees it as a discontinuity, and proxy pass-through including sequence omission from older peers.
The combined client/server input passes the full five-stage gate and independent Codex/Claude complete-branch reviews with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher findings.
